introduction: The Working Pennsylvanians Tax Credit is a refundable state credit based on federal EITC. Claim it through income-tax filing.
description: The Working Pennsylvanians Tax Credit is a refundable state credit based on federal EITC. Claim it through income-tax filing.

sections.who: The state lists Pennsylvania earned income, federal EITC eligibility and filing both federal Form 1040 and PA-40 as requirements.
sections.get: The credit equals 10% of federal EITC and can reduce state tax or increase a refund. Use the instructions for the year being filed.
sections.docs:
• Federal return showing EITC.
  • Wage and self-employment records.
  • PA-40 and the required federal return copy.
sections.apply:
1. File the federal return

    Determine federal EITC and complete Form 1040.

  2. File Pennsylvania taxes

    Use tax software or myPATH. Enter the requested federal credit and provide the federal return.

  3. Include evidence for paper filing

    Mail the required Form 1040 copy with PA-40 so Revenue can verify eligibility.
sections.after: The online calculator is an estimate and cannot replace the credit calculation on your return. Keep both filings.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using Working Pennsylvanians Tax Credit. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.

faqs: Can it produce a refund without state tax owed?
No. Claim it through tax returns.
What if I file federal taxes elsewhere?
myPATH asks for federal EITC information and a Form 1040 upload.
No. Revenue determines the final result from the filed information.
